Mantine

Water Flying

Johto · Generation 2

Mantine is a Water/Flying-type Kite Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 2.1 m tall and weighs 220 kg. It evolves from Mantyke. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (140), with a base stat total of 485.
